en.answer: In this scenario, when resolving the effect of <<12068>>, even if there is a monster on your side of the field, the effect is applied normally.
en.question: If I activate the effect of <<12068>>, but then chain <<4989>> so that I now have a new monster on my side of the field when the effect of <<12068>> resolves, is the effect still applied?

ja.answer: 質問の状況のように、「<<12068>>」の効果処理時に、自分フィールドにモンスターが存在している場合でも、効果処理は通常通り適用されます。
